isa_target.source: docs/implementation-plan.md#1.1 p2 row: p1 plus F/D and the full claimed set of RVV 1.0 instructions and CSRs, initial VLEN=128, ELEN=64

derived_notes: VLEN is fixed for the whole life of a hart; runtime lane quota changes (I-059) must never change architectural VLEN.
Zkt/Zvkt apply only to instructions actually implemented; an unimplemented instruction cannot be excused by claiming Zkt.

The test protocol lives in RAM, not in the test_harness device region: HTIF, and therefore Spike, can only poll a tohost address that is real memory, and placing tohost in memory is the universal bare-metal convention. The test_harness region remains mapped for the harness to recognise, but TOHOST itself is an ordinary memory word the harness observes after the run.
